Garneau Classroom Feature: Limericks



*Mr. Lawrence’s grade 9 English class has been studying limericks. We’ve chosen a few written by his students to be featured here.* 



![][image1]  

*Illustration: Lila Huang*











I had an awful dream.



I woke up with a scream.



My friend came in,



Gave me a grin,



Then smacked me with some cream.



*By Sabeen Asif*



![][image2]  

*Illustration: Joy Wang*



I love Justin Bieber.



He’s not a brown beaver.



He sings so well,



He’s hot as hell,



Now I got the fever.



*By Malina Gori*







![][image3]  

*Illustration: Jeffrey Liu*



I had to clean the floor.



And then I slammed the door.



Drove to a shop,



And bought a mop,



But then slipped at the store.



*By Amina Baig*
